title: Scroll-to-fly 3D project space (camera flythrough)
description: Scroll flies a camera through project cards scattered along a 3-turn spiral in CSS 3D space. Depth wraps infinitely, cards fade in from the deep and out past the lens, a starfield stretches on the z-axis with velocity for warp streaks, the whole world tilts with the mouse, and perspective tightens as you accelerate. A HUD reads out velocity and camera z.

params.scatter: angle = i/count * PI*6; x = cos*26vw, y = sin*24vh; rotZ = ±7deg random
params.fade: in over z -3000→-2000, out over z 100→500, wrap at count*zGap
params.warp: perspective = 1000 - min(|vel|*6, 600); star scale3d(1,1, 1+|vel|*0.12 clamped to 10)
params.hover: rect hit-test +22px margin, nearest card lerps +50px toward camera at 0.12

a11y: prefers-reduced-motion: no flight — wheel hijack, starfield and tilt are skipped and cards render as a static scrollable grid.
